title: Five layers of Android
body:
Android is a stack of five layers, top to bottom:
Applications · Application Framework · Android Runtime · Platform Libraries · Linux Kernel.
Each layer serves the layer above it.
explain: Higher layers hide the difficult details of lower layers (abstraction). That is why the same app runs on phones with different hardware.

quick_check.q: Name the five layers from the top.
quick_check.a: Applications, Application Framework, Android Runtime, Platform Libraries, Linux Kernel.

id.title: Lima layer Android
id.body:
Android adalah tumpukan lima layer, dari atas ke bawah:
Applications · Application Framework · Android Runtime · Platform Libraries · Linux Kernel.
Setiap layer melayani layer di atasnya.
id.explain: Layer atas menyembunyikan detail rumit layer bawah (abstraksi). Karena itu app yang sama bisa jalan di ponsel dengan hardware berbeda.

quick_check.q: Sebutkan lima layer dari atas.
quick_check.a: Applications, Application Framework, Android Runtime, Platform Libraries, Linux Kernel.

title: Layer 1: Applications
body:
The top layer, visible to the user: built-in apps (Phone, Camera, Contacts, Gallery) and third-party apps (chat, games).
Each app normally runs in its own sandboxed process.

quick_check.q: Is a chat app from the Play Store in the Applications layer?
quick_check.a: Yes. Third-party apps live in this layer too.

id.title: Layer 1: Applications
id.body:
Layer paling atas yang terlihat user: app bawaan (Phone, Camera, Contacts, Gallery) dan app pihak ketiga (chat, game).
Setiap app biasanya berjalan di proses sandbox sendiri.

quick_check.q: Apakah app chat dari Play Store ada di layer Applications?
quick_check.a: Ya. App pihak ketiga juga ada di layer ini.

title: Layer 2: Application Framework
body:
High-level services and APIs used to build apps.
Activity Manager · Notification Manager · Package Manager · Location Manager · Window Manager · Resource Manager · Connectivity Manager.
explain: Think of a service desk between your app and the lower system: your code asks, the framework coordinates the work.

quick_check.q: Which layer contains Activity Manager and Notification Manager?

id.title: Layer 2: Application Framework
id.body:
Layanan dan API tingkat tinggi untuk membuat app.
Activity Manager · Notification Manager · Package Manager · Location Manager · Window Manager · Resource Manager · Connectivity Manager.
id.explain: Bayangkan meja layanan antara app dan sistem di bawahnya: kode kamu meminta, framework mengatur pekerjaannya.

quick_check.q: Layer mana yang berisi Activity Manager dan Notification Manager?

title: Layer 3: Android Runtime (ART)
body:
Executes the app's DEX bytecode and provides memory management, garbage collection and threading.
Core libraries let apps be written in Java and Kotlin.
explain:
[NOTE] The older slides name the Dalvik virtual machine; the newer slides say modern Android uses ART instead of Dalvik. Write "Android Runtime (ART)" in answers.
Flow: Kotlin/Java source → build tools → DEX bytecode → ART → CPU.

quick_check.q: Which layer executes DEX bytecode?

id.title: Layer 3: Android Runtime (ART)
id.body:
Menjalankan DEX bytecode app dan menyediakan manajemen memori, garbage collection, dan threading.
Core libraries memungkinkan app ditulis dengan Java dan Kotlin.
id.explain:
[NOTE] Slide lama menyebut Dalvik virtual machine; slide baru bilang Android modern memakai ART, bukan Dalvik. Tulis "Android Runtime (ART)" di jawaban.
Alur: source Kotlin/Java → build tools → DEX bytecode → ART → CPU.

quick_check.q: Layer mana yang menjalankan DEX bytecode?

title: Layer 4: Platform Libraries
body: Native C/C++ libraries: SQLite (database), OpenGL ES / Vulkan (graphics), Media (audio/video codecs), SSL (secure link), WebKit (web content), FreeType (fonts).

quick_check.q: Where do SQLite and OpenGL live?

id.title: Layer 4: Platform Libraries
id.body: Library native C/C++: SQLite (database), OpenGL ES / Vulkan (grafik), Media (codec audio/video), SSL (koneksi aman), WebKit (konten web), FreeType (font).

quick_check.q: Di layer mana SQLite dan OpenGL?

title: Layer 5: Linux Kernel
body:
The foundation. It manages device drivers (camera, display, Bluetooth, audio), memory, processes, networking and low-level security.
It sits between hardware and the other layers.
explain: Its five features: security, memory management, process management, network stack, driver model.

quick_check.q: Which layer contains the device drivers?

id.title: Layer 5: Linux Kernel
id.body:
Fondasinya. Mengatur driver perangkat (kamera, layar, Bluetooth, audio), memori, proses, jaringan, dan keamanan tingkat rendah.
Berada di antara hardware dan layer lain.
id.explain: Lima fiturnya: security, memory management, process management, network stack, driver model.

quick_check.q: Layer mana yang berisi driver perangkat?

title: An app never touches hardware directly
body:
A request goes down the layers and back up.
Taking a photo: App → Camera API → camera system service → native libraries → driver → camera hardware.

wrong_right.wrong: "My app talks directly to the camera."
wrong_right.right: "My app calls a Camera API; services and drivers reach the hardware."
wrong_right.reason: Apps normally use framework APIs and system services (slide: Common Misunderstandings).

quick_check.q: Why use framework APIs instead of the hardware?

id.title: App tidak pernah menyentuh hardware langsung
id.body:
Permintaan turun lewat layer lalu naik kembali.
Mengambil foto: App → Camera API → camera system service → library native → driver → hardware kamera.
id.wrong_right_reason: App biasanya memakai API framework dan system service (slide: Common Misunderstandings).

quick_check.q: Kenapa pakai API framework, bukan hardware langsung?

title: Framework, Libraries, Runtime: do not mix up
body:
Framework = managers for developers (Activity, Notification).
Platform Libraries = native tools (SQLite, OpenGL, Media).
ART = runs app code. ART is not the Linux Kernel.

quick_check.q: Is ART the same as the Linux Kernel?
quick_check.a: No. ART is the managed runtime; the kernel is the low-level OS foundation.

id.title: Framework, Libraries, Runtime: jangan tertukar
id.body:
Framework = manajer untuk developer (Activity, Notification).
Platform Libraries = alat native (SQLite, OpenGL, Media).
ART = menjalankan kode app. ART bukan Linux Kernel.

quick_check.q: Apakah ART sama dengan Linux Kernel?
quick_check.a: Tidak. ART adalah managed runtime; kernel adalah fondasi OS tingkat rendah.

title: Four app components
body:
Activity: a screen the user interacts with.
Service: background or long-running work.
BroadcastReceiver: responds to system or app events.
ContentProvider: shares structured data.
explain: An app also has resources (layouts, strings, images, themes) and AndroidManifest.xml.

quick_check.q: Which component keeps music playing after you leave the screen?

id.title: Empat komponen app
id.body:
Activity: layar yang berinteraksi dengan user.
Service: pekerjaan latar belakang atau lama.
BroadcastReceiver: merespons event sistem atau app.
ContentProvider: berbagi data terstruktur.
id.explain: App juga punya resources (layout, string, gambar, tema) dan AndroidManifest.xml.

quick_check.q: Komponen mana yang membuat musik tetap jalan setelah kamu meninggalkan layar?

title: Activity: a screen with behavior
body: An Activity is usually one screen. onCreate() sets it up; setContentView() connects the Java code to the XML layout.

quick_check.q: What does setContentView() do?
quick_check.a: Connects the Java Activity to its XML layout.

id.title: Activity: layar dengan perilaku
id.body: Activity biasanya satu layar. onCreate() menyiapkannya; setContentView() menghubungkan kode Java ke layout XML.

quick_check.q: Apa fungsi setContentView()?
quick_check.a: Menghubungkan Activity Java ke layout XML-nya.

title: Keywords for Service, Receiver, Provider
body:
Service = works with no visible screen.
BroadcastReceiver = listens for announcements (alarm fired, battery low).
ContentProvider = controlled data sharing between apps.

quick_check.q: Which component receives a scheduled reminder broadcast?

id.title: Kata kunci Service, Receiver, Provider
id.body:
Service = bekerja tanpa layar terlihat.
BroadcastReceiver = mendengar pengumuman (alarm berbunyi, baterai lemah).
ContentProvider = berbagi data terkontrol antar app.

quick_check.q: Komponen mana yang menerima broadcast pengingat terjadwal?

title: AndroidManifest.xml
body:
Declares the components, permissions and capabilities of the app, and which Activity opens first (MAIN + LAUNCHER).
An Activity that is not listed cannot start ("Activity not found").

quick_check.q: Where must every Activity be registered?

id.title: AndroidManifest.xml
id.body:
Mendeklarasikan komponen, permission, dan kemampuan app, serta Activity yang dibuka pertama (MAIN + LAUNCHER).
Activity yang tidak terdaftar tidak bisa jalan ("Activity not found").

quick_check.q: Di mana setiap Activity harus didaftarkan?

title: Intent: open another screen
body:
[ADDED] An Intent is a request to Android, for example "open another Activity". putExtra() sends a small value along.
The Expense Tracker sends the chosen month to the Summary screen this way.

quick_check.q: Which component is used to request opening another Activity?

id.title: Intent: membuka layar lain
id.body:
[ADDED] Intent adalah permintaan ke Android, misalnya "buka Activity lain". putExtra() mengirim nilai kecil bersamanya.
Expense Tracker mengirim bulan terpilih ke layar Summary dengan cara ini.

quick_check.q: Komponen mana yang dipakai untuk meminta membuka Activity lain?

title: The lifecycle order
body:
onCreate() → onStart() → onResume() → user interacts → onPause() → onStop() → onDestroy().
Android controls this order, not your code.

quick_check.q: Which method is called first when an Activity starts?

id.title: Urutan lifecycle
id.body:
onCreate() → onStart() → onResume() → user berinteraksi → onPause() → onStop() → onDestroy().
Android yang mengatur urutan ini, bukan kodemu.

quick_check.q: Method mana yang dipanggil pertama saat Activity mulai?

title: Why the lifecycle matters
body:
A user can leave, return, rotate or close the app. Android may recreate an Activity after rotation or memory pressure.
Save important information instead of assuming the screen stays alive.
explain: onDestroy(): the Activity may be removed. A normal variable is lost then, which is why the Study Planner stores data in SharedPreferences.

quick_check.q: When may onPause() / onStop() be called?
quick_check.a: When the app moves to the background.

id.title: Kenapa lifecycle penting
id.body:
User bisa keluar, kembali, memutar layar, atau menutup app. Android bisa membuat ulang Activity setelah rotasi atau memori penuh.
Simpan informasi penting, jangan berasumsi layar selalu hidup.
id.explain: onDestroy(): Activity mungkin dihapus. Variabel biasa hilang saat itu, karena itu Study Planner menyimpan data di SharedPreferences.

quick_check.q: Kapan onPause() / onStop() bisa dipanggil?
quick_check.a: Saat app pindah ke latar belakang.

title: XML = looks, Java = actions
body:
XML describes what the screen looks like. Java describes what happens when the user interacts.
If you can see it (text, colour, position) → XML. If it is an action or a calculation → Activity.

quick_check.q: Where do you change the text of a button?

id.title: XML = tampilan, Java = aksi
id.body:
XML menjelaskan seperti apa tampilan layar. Java menjelaskan apa yang terjadi saat user berinteraksi.
Kalau terlihat (teks, warna, posisi) → XML. Kalau aksi atau hitungan → Activity.

quick_check.q: Di mana kamu mengubah teks tombol?

title: Layouts
body:
LinearLayout: arranges views vertically or horizontally.
ScrollView: scrolls when content does not fit.
ConstraintLayout: positions views relative to constraints.
Teaching choice: a vertical LinearLayout inside a ScrollView.

quick_check.q: Which layout arranges elements vertically or horizontally?

id.title: Layout
id.body:
LinearLayout: menyusun view vertikal atau horizontal.
ScrollView: bisa di-scroll saat isi tidak muat.
ConstraintLayout: posisi view relatif terhadap constraint.
Pilihan mengajar: LinearLayout vertikal di dalam ScrollView.

quick_check.q: Layout mana yang menyusun elemen vertikal atau horizontal?

title: Common widgets
body:
EditText: the user types input.
Button: Add, Save, Calculate.
TextView: non-editable text (totals, results).
ListView: a list of records.
TimePickerDialog: choose a time.
ProgressBar: loading.

quick_check.q: Which widget shows non-editable text?

id.title: Widget yang umum
id.body:
EditText: user mengetik input.
Button: Add, Save, Calculate.
TextView: teks yang tidak bisa diedit (total, hasil).
ListView: daftar data.
TimePickerDialog: memilih jam.
ProgressBar: loading.

quick_check.q: Widget mana yang menampilkan teks yang tidak bisa diedit?

title: IDs connect XML to Java
body:
Give each view an android:id in XML, then find it with findViewById() in Java. The two names must match exactly.
findViewById finds the view; getText() reads what is typed in it.

wrong_right.reason: The id in Java must match the XML exactly, or the view is not found (red error or crash). Slide: Debugging, "Check XML IDs and findViewById() names".

quick_check.q: What does findViewById return: the box or its content?
quick_check.a: The box (the view). Use getText().toString() for the content.

id.title: ID menghubungkan XML ke Java
id.body:
Beri setiap view android:id di XML, lalu temukan dengan findViewById() di Java. Kedua nama harus persis sama.
findViewById menemukan view; getText() membaca isi yang diketik.
id.wrong_right_reason: Id di Java harus persis sama dengan XML, kalau tidak view tidak ketemu (error merah atau crash). Slide: Debugging, "Check XML IDs and findViewById() names".

quick_check.q: Apa yang dikembalikan findViewById: kotaknya atau isinya?

title: Design principles
body:
Clarity: meaningful labels.
Consistency: similar spacing and styles.
Feedback: show success, error, loading and empty states.
Accessibility: readable text, large tap targets.
Validation: block blank or wrong input before saving.

quick_check.q: Name two design principles.
quick_check.a: For example Clarity and Validation (any two of the five).

id.title: Prinsip desain
id.body:
Clarity: label yang bermakna.
Consistency: spasi dan gaya yang seragam.
Feedback: tampilkan status sukses, error, loading, dan kosong.
Accessibility: teks terbaca, area tap besar.
Validation: cegah input kosong atau salah sebelum disimpan.

quick_check.q: Sebutkan dua prinsip desain.
quick_check.a: Misalnya Clarity dan Validation (dua dari lima mana saja).

title: The event pattern
body:
Every interactive feature follows five steps:
find view → listen for click → validate → process → update UI.
This is the pattern for the long exam questions.

quick_check.q: What is the step right after "listen for click"?

id.title: Pola event
id.body:
Setiap fitur interaktif mengikuti lima langkah:
find view → listen for click → validate → process → update UI.
Ini pola untuk soal panjang di ujian.

quick_check.q: Apa langkah tepat setelah "listen for click"?

title: Validation: reject what is wrong
body:
[ADDED] Three checks for a number input: empty, not a number, zero or negative.
Check the text first, convert it to a number, then compare with 0. Show the error with setError() and return.

wrong_right.reason: Reject the wrong case. >= 0 would reject valid hours; <= 0 rejects 0 and negatives.

quick_check.q: Which comparison rejects both 0 and negative hours?

id.title: Validasi: tolak yang salah
id.body:
[ADDED] Tiga cek untuk input angka: kosong, bukan angka, nol atau negatif.
Cek teksnya dulu, ubah jadi angka, baru bandingkan dengan 0. Tampilkan error dengan setError() lalu return.
id.wrong_right_reason: Tolak kasus yang salah. >= 0 akan menolak jam yang valid; <= 0 menolak 0 dan negatif.

quick_check.q: Perbandingan mana yang menolak 0 sekaligus jam negatif?

title: Worked example: Parking Fee
body:
[ADDED] Mock exam Q12: Rs. 100 per hour. Read the hours, validate, compute fee = hours × 100, show "Total Fee: Rs. 300" for 3 hours.
Never hard-code the result.

quick_check.q: What is displayed for 3 hours?

id.title: Contoh: Parking Fee
id.body:
[ADDED] Mock exam Q12: Rs. 100 per jam. Baca jam, validasi, hitung fee = jam × 100, tampilkan "Total Fee: Rs. 300" untuk 3 jam.
Jangan menulis hasil secara langsung.

quick_check.q: Apa yang tampil untuk 3 jam?

title: Toast and setError
body:
[ADDED] Toast: a short message that appears for a moment and disappears by itself (for example "Saved").
setError(): a red message on an input field.
Toast is also used to check that a click runs (debugging).

quick_check.q: Which Android feature shows a brief confirmation message?

id.title: Toast dan setError
id.body:
[ADDED] Toast: pesan singkat yang muncul sebentar lalu hilang sendiri (misalnya "Saved").
setError(): pesan merah pada kolom input.
Toast juga dipakai untuk memastikan klik berjalan (debugging).

quick_check.q: Fitur Android mana yang menampilkan pesan konfirmasi singkat?

title: Which storage?
body:
SharedPreferences: small settings or simple values (last food order, reminder list).
SQLite: structured records with several fields (students, attendance, transactions).
Simple key-value → SharedPreferences; related records → SQLite.

quick_check.q: A single saved value after closing the app: which storage?

id.title: Penyimpanan mana?
id.body:
SharedPreferences: pengaturan kecil atau nilai sederhana (pesanan terakhir, daftar pengingat).
SQLite: data terstruktur dengan banyak field (siswa, absensi, transaksi).
Key-value sederhana → SharedPreferences; data berkaitan → SQLite.

quick_check.q: Satu nilai yang disimpan setelah app ditutup: penyimpanan mana?

title: SharedPreferences: the small notebook
body:
[ADDED] Stores name-value pairs that stay after the app is closed. A normal variable is lost.
Save with edit().putString(...).apply(); restore with getString(key, default) in onCreate().

quick_check.q: Why not keep the subject in a normal variable?
quick_check.a: The variable is lost when the app closes.

id.title: SharedPreferences: buku catatan kecil
id.body:
[ADDED] Menyimpan pasangan nama-nilai yang tetap ada setelah app ditutup. Variabel biasa hilang.
Simpan dengan edit().putString(...).apply(); pulihkan dengan getString(key, default) di onCreate().

quick_check.q: Kenapa subjek tidak disimpan di variabel biasa?

title: TimePickerDialog and the Study Planner
body:
[ADDED] Mock exam Q13: enter a subject, pick a time with a TimePickerDialog, tap Save Plan, show it again after reopening.
Validate: subject not empty and a time chosen.

quick_check.q: What does the user choose with a TimePickerDialog?

id.title: TimePickerDialog dan Study Planner
id.body:
[ADDED] Mock exam Q13: isi subjek, pilih jam dengan TimePickerDialog, tekan Save Plan, tampilkan lagi setelah app dibuka ulang.
Validasi: subjek tidak kosong dan jam sudah dipilih.

quick_check.q: Apa yang dipilih user dengan TimePickerDialog?

title: SQLite and CRUD
body:
SQLite stores data in tables, rows and columns. The four basic operations are CRUD: Create, Read, Update, Delete.
Example: register a student, show attendance, change a daily status, delete a record.

quick_check.q: What does CRUD stand for?

id.title: SQLite dan CRUD
id.body:
SQLite menyimpan data dalam tabel, baris, dan kolom. Empat operasi dasarnya CRUD: Create, Read, Update, Delete.
Contoh: daftarkan siswa, tampilkan absensi, ubah status harian, hapus data.

quick_check.q: CRUD singkatan dari apa?

title: Money as integer cents
body:
The Expense Tracker stores 12.50 as 1250 cents. Decimal (floating point) numbers can cause rounding errors; integers are exact.
Balance = income − expenses.

quick_check.q: Why store money as integer cents?
quick_check.a: To avoid rounding errors of floating-point numbers.

id.title: Uang sebagai integer cents
id.body:
Expense Tracker menyimpan 12.50 sebagai 1250 cents. Bilangan desimal (floating point) bisa menimbulkan galat pembulatan; integer itu tepat.
Balance = pemasukan − pengeluaran.

quick_check.q: Kenapa uang disimpan sebagai integer cents?
quick_check.a: Untuk menghindari galat pembulatan bilangan floating point.

title: Web APIs and JSON
body:
An API returns data, often as JSON. Weather app flow: search city → geocoding API → coordinates → forecast API → show weather.
Show loading, no-result and network-error states.

quick_check.q: What should happen if the city does not exist?
quick_check.a: Show a useful message and allow another search; never stay on "Loading...".

id.chapter: 7. Web API dan Pekerjaan Latar Belakang
id.title: Web API dan JSON
id.body:
API mengembalikan data, sering berupa JSON. Alur app cuaca: cari kota → geocoding API → koordinat → forecast API → tampilkan cuaca.
Tampilkan status loading, tidak ada hasil, dan error jaringan.

quick_check.q: Apa yang harus terjadi jika kota tidak ada?
quick_check.a: Tampilkan pesan yang berguna dan izinkan pencarian lain; jangan terjebak di "Loading...".

title: Permission and background thread
body: Add the INTERNET permission in the Manifest. Run network requests on a background thread (Executor) so the screen does not freeze, then update the UI with runOnUiThread.

quick_check.q: Why must weather requests not run on the main UI thread?

id.chapter: 7. Web API dan Pekerjaan Latar Belakang
id.title: Permission dan background thread
id.body: Tambahkan permission INTERNET di Manifest. Jalankan request jaringan di background thread (Executor) supaya layar tidak membeku, lalu update UI dengan runOnUiThread.

quick_check.q: Kenapa request cuaca tidak boleh di main UI thread?

title: Reminders: alarm, receiver, notification
body:
Select time → schedule alarm (AlarmManager) → the system fires → BroadcastReceiver → notification.
Android 13+ needs notification permission; Android 8+ needs a notification channel. Inexact alarms can be delayed.

quick_check.q: Which component builds the notification when the alarm fires?

id.chapter: 7. Web API dan Pekerjaan Latar Belakang
id.title: Pengingat: alarm, receiver, notifikasi
id.body:
Pilih jam → jadwalkan alarm (AlarmManager) → sistem memicu → BroadcastReceiver → notifikasi.
Android 13+ butuh permission notifikasi; Android 8+ butuh notification channel. Alarm tidak tepat bisa tertunda.

quick_check.q: Komponen mana yang membuat notifikasi saat alarm berbunyi?

title: The five projects compared
body:
1 Expense Tracker: SQLite, multiple screens.
2 Weather Forecast: web API, JSON, ProgressBar.
3 Attendance: SQLite two tables.
4 Medicine Reminder: TimePicker, SharedPreferences, alarm.
5 Food Ordering: arrays, loops, cart total.

quick_check.q: Which project uses a web API and JSON?

id.title: Perbandingan lima proyek
id.body:
1 Expense Tracker: SQLite, banyak layar.
2 Weather Forecast: web API, JSON, ProgressBar.
3 Attendance: SQLite dua tabel.
4 Medicine Reminder: TimePicker, SharedPreferences, alarm.
5 Food Ordering: array, loop, total keranjang.

quick_check.q: Proyek mana yang memakai web API dan JSON?

title: Formulas to know
body:
Attendance % = present days ÷ total recorded days × 100.
Cart total = sum of price × quantity (a loop over the arrays).
Balance = income − expenses.

quick_check.q: 8 present out of 10 recorded days: attendance?

id.title: Rumus yang perlu diketahui
id.body:
Attendance % = hari hadir ÷ total hari tercatat × 100.
Total keranjang = jumlah harga × kuantitas (loop pada array).
Balance = pemasukan − pengeluaran.

quick_check.q: Hadir 8 dari 10 hari tercatat: persentase kehadiran?

title: Plan, test, debug
body:
Plan: Problem → Screens → Data model → UI + Java → Test.
Test empty, wrong and repeated input, and save-then-restart.
Debug: read the first error in Logcat, check XML ids, confirm the Manifest Activity, use Toast to see that a click runs.

quick_check.q: What should you read first when debugging?
quick_check.a: The first meaningful error message in Build Output or Logcat.

id.title: Rencanakan, uji, debug
id.body:
Rencana: Problem → Screens → Data model → UI + Java → Test.
Uji input kosong, salah, dan berulang, serta simpan-lalu-restart.
Debug: baca error pertama di Logcat, cek id XML, pastikan Activity ada di Manifest, pakai Toast untuk memastikan klik berjalan.

quick_check.q: Apa yang dibaca pertama saat debugging?
quick_check.a: Pesan error pertama yang bermakna di Build Output atau Logcat.
